questions.question: (R366)(5)(i), the twelve ready orders read at today's tree and placed by the seat: DONE 1, HERE 1, WITH THE BUILD 5, LATER 5 (data/b756_orders_read.txt :87). DONE: W-ORD-LEDGER-SPLIT-RESOLVER, b754's cuts having met FINDINGS' size with no ledger line moving, so no cite needs a resolver (data/b756_orders_read.txt :62). HERE: W-ORD-LABEL-READER, one predicate in the standing roster reader and its planted control, under two hours, a standing change with VERSION moved (data/b756_orders_read.txt :23). WITH THE BUILD: KEIPER-FACE, E2-SEPARATION, BESSEL-BOUND-TIGHTEN, B518-FLOAT, EXPLICIT-FORMULA-C1. LATER, each with its trigger written again: STORMER-CLASH, TESTS-WITH-THE-LISTS-IN-FORCE, ROOT-BINARY-BANK, CHAIN-PAGE-B638-CASES, CORRESPONDENCE-BEHIND-SCOPE. The navigator read LEDGER-SPLIT-RESOLVER and CORRESPONDENCE-BEHIND-SCOPE as HERE; the bank prints why the seat places them otherwise. Do the twelve placements pass?

options.label: Pass as placed (Recommended)
options.description: The twelve placements stand: the statuses move by the orders tool's route in this act's trail, and W-ORD-LABEL-READER's predicate and control are done at this act.

options.label: Pass, HERE work carried
options.description: The placements stand, but W-ORD-LABEL-READER moves to LATER with the trigger 'the next act that changes the roster reader'; no HERE work at this act.

options.label: Strike the placements
options.description: No status moves at this act; the twelve stand as the orders tool reads them now, and the reading stays in its bank.

questions.question: (R366)(5)(ii), two lines for OPEN_TRAILS, each passed or struck. CP-7: 'CP-7 closed by this line, on the author's word: its editions ran from b576 to b599 (OPEN_TRAILS :11836, :12336) and no act since is headed CP-7; the keystones' further editions are the prose pass's and the re-cuts'.' CP-6: 'CP-6, the Phase 2 inheritance, was not run (last named at OPEN_TRAILS :12452); its work, each Phase 2 keystone's table stating its own content and that it inherits nothing from Phase 1, is carried as a condition of the Phase 2 wave's deposit.' The seat's read at PLACE-papers HEAD: the headings naming CP-7 run from :11836 to :12336 and none after; CP-6 is named once after :12452, at :18400, b755's Next line, which names this act's closing lines for CP-6 and CP-7. Which of the two lines pass?

options.label: Pass both (Recommended)
options.description: Both lines appended to OPEN_TRAILS in the ruling's words, under one dated head, by one PLACE-papers commit through the one-call tool.

options.label: Pass CP-7, strike CP-6
options.description: The CP-7 line written as given; the CP-6 line not written, CP-6 left as the trail now reads it.

options.label: Pass CP-6, strike CP-7
options.description: The CP-6 line written as given; the CP-7 line not written, CP-7 left as the trail now reads it.

options.label: Strike both
